newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA exports 2.645 mln bpd in 1H 1996-document.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA exports 2.645 mln bpd in 1H 1996-document.

text.p: Venezuelan state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) increased its crude and product exports to 2.645 million barrels per day (bpd) in the first half of 1996 from 2.447 million bpd in first-half 1995, according to a company report obtained by Reuters from government sources.
The report showed that PDVSA expects crude and products exports to average 2.727 million bpd over the year as a whole based on a daily total production of 3.140 million bpd.
Sales on the domestic market were 362,000 bpd in the first half of 1996 and are expected to average 374,000 bpd over the year, the document showed.
Venezuela has an Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) quota of 2.359 million bpd but is frequently cited by traders as producing well above that level.
Venezuelan government and oil industry officials routinely deny that the country is breaking its OPEC quota.
